name: Dried Apricots
siboNotes: The concentrated sorbitol in dried apricots can trigger symptoms even at small servings in sensitive individuals. Start with just 1-2 pieces to test tolerance.
preparationTips: Choose unsulfured varieties when possible to avoid additional digestive irritants
Soak briefly in warm water to rehydrate slightly and reduce concentration
Chop finely and mix into larger low-FODMAP portions to dilute the serving size
Store in airtight containers to maintain texture and prevent spoilage
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin A and beta-carotene for eye health
Good source of potassium for heart function
Contains dietary fiber for digestive health
